problems.message: ownLikes inherits horizon-free public sync (`sync public`, no horizon) from likes; its explicit `read <- .principal = viewer` (at schema.q:93:3) conflicts with that public audience. A maintained view cannot declare a separate sync audience
problems.rewrite: keep `read <- allow` (or omit read) to retain this public offline summary: every device receives every group, including other viewers' keys; use `online only` to keep the narrower read on the server and lose offline aggregate/absence coverage. Measure replica rows and bytes with `snapback4 test --residency`; guide maintains; guide offline-interactions
